source.stem:
Problem:

Consider the system
$$
x y = 10^{a}, \quad y z = 10^{b}, \quad x z = 10^{c}
$$

What is $\log x + \log y + \log z$?
(a) $\frac{a b c}{2}$
(b) $\frac{a+b+c}{2}$
(c) $a+b+c$
(d) $a b c$
